message.content:
This is a threaded screw of stainless steel, so it falls in heading 7318. Subheading 7318.14 covers self-tapping screws, and a thread-forming screw is a self-tapping type. The 7318.14 stainless-steel lines I recall are 7318.14.10 (cap screws... not sure) and 7318.14.20 (other). I am not certain of the exact statistical suffixes.

My recollection of the 7318.14 structure:
- 7318.14.10: Self-tapping screws, threaded, of stainless steel? In fact, 7318.14.10 is "Of stainless steel" with subdivisions: 7318.14.1000? I believe 7318.14.10 is "Of stainless steel" with sub-items 7318.14.1010 "Of stainless steel" in older versions.
- 7318.14.20: Other, 7318.14.2000? Not sure.
- 7318.14.30 and 7318.14.60: Other, with 7318.14.9030 and 7318.14.9060 for other.

The current structure, as I recall it:
- 7318.14.10: Self-tapping screws, threaded, of stainless steel? No.
- 7318.14.10 00 = "Having shanks or threads with a diameter of less than 6 mm" is not right either; that belongs to 7318.12/7318.15.

Going from the more reliable memory of 7318.14: 7318.14.10 covers "Of stainless steel", and the lines below it are 7318.14.1010 and 7318.14.1050. The "Other" group at 7318.14.90 has 7318.14.9030 and 7318.14.9060. A stainless screw of this kind would then go in 7318.14.10, with the 7318.14.1050 line being "Other".

I'm going with 7318.14.1050, but I'm unsure of the suffix.
